# Vercel: upload deployment files

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Vercel deployments require uploading files via a specific REST API endpoint. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact API endpoint path for file upload. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact request body schema and required fields. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact authentication method and token scope. Agents must extract these three facts to successfully upload deployment files without human intervention.

Search intents:
- Vercel deployment file upload
- Vercel REST API deploy
- Vercel API authentication

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-upload-deployment-files --json
